summary: Greenfield toolchain bootstrap with a static placeholder page. There are no runtime trust boundaries: no user input, network calls, storage or secrets. src/main.tsx and src/ui/App.tsx render only constant JSX, and index.html has no inline script or third-party origin. The built dist/ has no source maps or external URLs. Child processes in tests (tests/support/sandbox.ts, tests/toolchain/build.test.ts) use spawnSync('npm', argv[]) without a shell, and their arguments are constants. Sandboxes use mkdtempSync and are removed in finally blocks. Dependencies match the exact pins in spec section 5. All 225 lockfile entries resolve from registry.npmjs.org with sha512 integrity. The only install script is the optional fsevents package. .gitignore excludes .env, .env.*, dist, coverage and the report folders. I re-ran the audit locally: `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` exits 0. `npm audit --audit-level=critical` exits 0 with 13 high and 0 critical, and every high is the GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf picomatch chain (vite, vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8, typescript-eslint via tinyglobby/fdir). User decision Q-3 tolerates that chain, so this meets SPEC-24 and SPEC-25. No findings.
